status: PART 2, the fit declaration: the draft changed only by `changes`, each one of the protocol's enumerated decisions cited to its ladder (declare.py check-fit validates it)

changes.why: every 1x capture of every L3 rung pixel-identical to c05-control's

charter: docs/doperpowers/specs/2026-10-03-w44-texture-at-0-25.md (Design "The moves", "The landing rule"; Decision Logs 3 and 4)

references.why: every regression row and T1's change output read the published c05 generation by hash (X52)

fitCells: the gate partition of the light 0.25 profiles (every T1 cell less the canonical holdout and the referees), 2x WebGPU; the planner's pre-gate probe whitelist with the canonical calibration, validation and recorded sets; the loader refuses a referee row
searchProcedure: within a family, each leaf's grid is swept in the order listed, the others held at their current values, keeping the grid point with the smallest move objective; at most two passes; a full factorial sweep of a family's grids is permitted and is not required. The move objective is the selection metric restricted to the move's cells.

moves.cells: 2x WebGPU rest, spans mid and thick (96-160), fit cells, F u C u P
moves.withinClause: every F cell of `cells` within, AND every pitch-16 (`checkerboard`) and photo cell of `cells` within (T1 output 1)

A.prediction: A is not within on both ends: no floor in [0.6, 1.0] brings the F cells AND the pitch-16 and photo cells of the move within at once

B.prediction: B is within on the fine cells of the move and over (web above native, a miss) on checkerboard-64 and the photo

sizeHeavySecondSigma.inert: proven by L3: every 1x capture of every rung pixel-identical to c05-control's (ladders/results.json)

sizeHeavySecondSigma2x.unit: CSS px (3 CSS px = 6 device px at 2x)

C.prediction: C is within on both: some (share, width) brings the F cells AND the pitch-16 and photo cells of the move within

moves.ifNoFamilyIsWithin: the move takes the point with the smallest move objective across its families' searched points, a tie (within the selection tie) going to the fewer moved leaves, and is recorded as not within

moves.cells: 2x WebGPU rest, thin spans (32-44), fit cells, F u C u P

start.prediction: a start near 0.8 (in [0.7, 0.9]) brings the thin rest cells within at every pitch, because the reach already covers a thin span

moves.cells: 2x WebGPU inactive, every span, fit cells, F u C u P
moves.inherits: the receded document names exactly its 0.5 twin's keys (X44): sizeScatterFloor2x, the second tap and the reach come from the active document as moves 1 and 2 leave them

receded.prediction: the thin start is the lever (its sweep moves the inactive cells most); the receded fine cells reach Apple's near-zero only with the inherited floor at 1

interactions: after the three moves the full T1 map is re-read at the joint point; a move UNDID an earlier one when a cell of the earlier move's `cells` that it left within is a miss at the joint point; the undoing move is refitted once on the union of the two moves' cells; a second undoing closes the fit at the better joint point by the selection metric
notCandidates: sizeScatterScaleGain (one leaf for both scales; X48)

selectionRule.withinAMove: the first family, in the declared order, with a searched point that passes the move's within clause lands the move, at its point with the smallest move objective
selectionRule.atTheJointPoint: between candidates, the smaller selection metric lands: the median |log(web / native)| over F u C u P, 2x WebGPU light, gate partition (t1.selection_metric)
selectionRule.tie: two metrics within the selection tie of each other (the median over the same cells of log(1 + bar / native), t1.selection_tie) tie, and the tie goes to the fewer moved leaves

landingRule.scope: the final stage, WebGPU, 2x light, both poses, F u C u P less the referees, from T1's three outputs (t1.landing)
landingRule.fullClose: every F cell within; no cell away with g > B; no cell overshoot; every other adopted row passing or its miss named; the twelve referees within at the exposure. Lands.
landingRule.improvement: the F aggregate (median |log((k + eps) / (n + eps))|) at most half of c05's; no cell away with g > B; no cell overshoot; every referee within or an unchanged miss; every other adopted row passing or its miss named. Lands as improved, every F cell not within named.
landingRule.regressionBudget: a C or P cell that is a miss on c05 and unchanged stays a named miss; one away with g <= B is a named regression inside the budget; one with g > B fails the landing; M2 keeps its own 0.02 reference-relative tolerance as a regression stop
landingRule.cssTier: a residual: its T1 outputs recorded; its tables pass or are named; a CSS row away beyond its table bound is a named tier residual
landingRule.unmeasured: a member of the scope with no reading makes the verdict UNMEASURED, never a landing
landingRule.otherwise: the wave closes at the finding: no document sealed, T1 lands in the owner test (X51)

permittedChanges: remove a leaf (or a family whose every leaf is struck) that its ladder struck, citing the ladder by id
replace C's `inert` PENDING with the L3 citation once L3 proves the 1x byte identity (the value stays 0), or remove family C when L3 does not
narrow a grid to the subset inside its ladder's non-flat range, citing the ladder by id
